structure: Part 12 mined the three end-to-end traces of journeys.fit.spec.js (describe 'notification journeys end to end'), every action of each read from the full action list and every journey page snapshotted with main innerText, form fields, hints, back link and classes. Refs name the trace by its zip and the action id the snapshot was taken at. TRACE C = journeys--notification-journeys-end-to-end-cattle-by-air-identification-unweaned-question-cph-number.zip (journeys.fit.spec.js › notification journeys end to end › cattle by air: identification, unweaned question, CPH number; 259 actions; reference GBN-AG-26-0W1JKI). TRACE H = journeys--notification-journeys-end-to-end-horse-by-sea-temporary-admission.zip (journeys.fit.spec.js:317 › notification journeys end to end › horse by sea: temporary admission; 246 actions, 0 errors; reference GBN-AG-26-0SWFHC). TRACE G = journeys--notification-journeys-end-to-end-germinal-products-bovine-semen-with-donor-identification.zip (› germinal products: bovine semen with donor identification; 239 actions; reference GBN-AG-26-0ZMQHI). Page order, cattle by air: create-notification (302) > notification-type 'What are you importing?' (live animals) > origin-of-the-import > what-are-you-importing (commodity search) > reason-for-import > consignment-details 'Commodity details' > animal-identification-details (one entry per animal, save and add another) > additional-animal-details (certified for + unweaned question) > arrival-details > transporter > upload-documents (add another then continue) > roles-and-addresses 'Consignment addresses' with place-of-origin, consignor-or-exporter, consignee, importer, place-of-destination and cph-number sub-pages each returning to it > contact-address-for-consignment > review-notification (POST redirect lands here) > [test navigates to notification-hub 'Overview', all tasks Complete] > review-notification > declaration (submit without the box shows an error, then with it) > notification-submitted > review-notification?reference=<ref> (submitted view). Horse by sea: same order with Temporary admission horses reason (exit date + port of exit reveal), three identifiers per horse (Microchip, Passport, Horse name), no unweaned question, no CPH section. Germinal products: create-notification?category=germinal-products skips the notification-type page and lands on origin-of-the-import (back link /germinal-products); the commodity-details page asks weight, packages and storage temperature; identification asks donor, collection and production dates and identification mark; no additional-details page; a transit-countries page follows arrival details; hub lists Transit countries and no Additional details. Network: every journey page is a server-rendered GET plus a POST that 302-redirects (GOV.UK Prototype Kit, Express, on localhost:3010); no data API calls fired; the remaining traffic is static assets and browser-sync live reload (excluded as harness noise). Notable findings recorded as claims: the submitted view shows the same canned cattle notification (Bison bison, LIV-2026-0142) whatever was submitted; captions, button wording (overview vs hub) and date hints differ between pages; review labels differ from page labels; the species 'Equus caballus' renders as 'Equus cabalus'.

claims.statement: The declaration page is titled 'Declaration' and states the user is the UK contact and complies with Regulation (EU) 2017/625.
claims.ref: TRACE C actions 198-203 and action 201 snapshot
claims.quote:
Declaration
I am the contact for the authorities and located in the UK.

I am complying with the requirements of Regulation (EU) 2017/625 including on animal health and welfare.

I confirm I am responsible for this consignment.

claims.statement: The declaration sets out how long the user is responsible for the consignment.
claims.quote:
I am responsible from the submission of this notification to when it enters Great Britain. And I am responsible until it has either:

cleared official checks at the border
reached the Place of Destination as stated on the health certificate or notification

claims.statement: The declaration lists the costs the user is accountable for.
claims.quote:
I confirm that I am accountable for:
any payment for the official controls at the border
any arrangements to re-dispatch the consignment
any costs needed for quarantine or isolation of consignments
any costs needed for destruction and disposal of consignments, when instructed by the authorities

claims.statement: The declaration covers acting for a third party.
claims.quote:
I am authorised as being accountable for these things if raising notifications on behalf of a third party.

I can legally act on behalf of a third party in relation to the conditions of this declaration.
